preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round_data, tuple) and len(round_data) == 2 for round_data in x)
preconditions.description: Input x is a list of tuples, where each tuple contains a dictionary and a boolean.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(round_data[0], dict) and isinstance(round_data[1], bool) for round_data in x)
preconditions.description: Each tuple in x contains a dictionary (round results) and a boolean (explosive flag).

preconditions.expression: all('P1' in round_data[0] and 'P2' in round_data[0] for round_data in x)
preconditions.description: Each dictionary in x contains exactly the keys 'P1' and 'P2'.

preconditions.expression: all(len(round_data[0]['P1']) == 2 and len(round_data[0]['P2']) == 2 for round_data in x)
preconditions.description: Each 'P1' and 'P2' value in the dictionary is a string of length 2, representing 2 shots.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in 'XO' for c in round_data[0]['P1']) and all(c in 'XO' for c in round_data[0]['P2']) for round_data in x)
preconditions.description: Each character in 'P1' and 'P2' strings is either 'X' (hit) or 'O' (miss).
Input x contains exactly 3 rounds of data.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'Pete Wins!' if (sum(sum(2 if round_data[1] else 1 for c in round_data[0]['P1'] if c == 'X') for round_data in x) > sum(sum(2 if round_data[1] else 1 for c in round_data[0]['P2'] if c == 'X') for round_data in x)) else 'Phil Wins!' if (sum(sum(2 if round_data[1] else 1 for c in round_data[0]['P1'] if c == 'X') for round_data in x) < sum(sum(2 if round_data[1] else 1 for c in round_data[0]['P2'] if c == 'X') for round_data in x)) else 'Draw!'
postconditions.description: The return value is 'Pete Wins!' if Pete's total score (sum of hits, with 2 points per hit if explosive is true, else 1) is strictly greater than Phil's. It is 'Phil Wins!' if Phil's total score is strictly greater. Otherwise, it is 'Draw!'
